name: experience-layer-digest-extract
title: Experience Layer prep: extract canonical-JSON-digest into a leaf core/digest.ts (behaviour-preserving refactor for Phase 2)
description: Behaviour-preserving refactor before Phase 2: extract the canonical-JSON-digest primitives (Digestable, canonicalJson, digestCanonicalJson, digestText) verbatim from handlers/decision-doc-promotion.ts into a new leaf packages/main/src/core/digest.ts, and have decision-doc-promotion.ts import them. This lets the future handlers/playbook.ts (Phase 2) clone the digest-integrity pattern by importing from a core leaf rather than a handler. All digest VALUES stay byte-identical, so existing decision-doc proposalDigest/sourceDigest values remain valid. No behaviour change. Proven by a smoke that digest output is identical on pinned inputs and that decision-doc-promotion behaviour is unchanged.
